**Note:** this repository's issue tracker is for bugs in the *source code itself* — compile errors, build failures, source-level defects. For a product-level bug in the ShaderOS tool (something that behaves incorrectly at runtime in the Editor), please use the [Bug Reports Discord channel](https://discord.gg/XPMGcdnpmn) instead, per [SUPPORT.md](../../SUPPORT.md).
